title: LLMS-Explorer
summary: Reference, reasoning and worked examples for llms.txt families — the spec, the rubric, conceptual vs proprietary files, vocabulary files — plus the concept tree, a directory of every known llms file with its conformance grade, and a recorded keyword/vector/hybrid run.
note: Companion files: llms-full.txt (every page in full), llms-small.txt (the reference, essays and examples layers within ~50k tokens), llms-facts.txt (source-anchored units), llms-vocabulary.txt (the terms of this niche).
